mysql_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the MySQL/MariaDB server.

mysql_port.description: TCP port on which the MySQL server listens.

mysql_user.description: Database user account used by Orthanc to authenticate.

mysql_password.description: Password for the MySQL user. Must be provided — Orthanc cannot start without it.

mysql_database.description: Name of the MySQL database to use for Orthanc data.

mysql_plugin_path.description: Absolute path to the MySQL plugin shared library (.so).

mysql_pool_min.description: Minimum number of connections kept open in the connection pool.

mysql_pool_max.description: Maximum number of connections allowed in the connection pool.

mysql_pool_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a free connection from the pool before failing.

mysql_use_ssl.description: Enable TLS/SSL encryption for connections to MySQL (recommended for production).

mysql_ssl_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file for SSL verification. Required if `mysql_use_ssl` is true.

mysql_ssl_cert.description: Path to client certificate file for mutual TLS (optional; leave empty for server-only auth).

mysql_ssl_key.description: Path to client private key file for mutual TLS (required if using client certificates).

mysql_init_command.description: SQL command to run after each new connection is established.

mysql_encoding.description: Character encoding used for database communication (must be supported by MySQL).
